header.title: Zoom
header.description: Scales the content. `variant` sets the pattern (`in`, `out`, `pulse` or `lens`), `trigger` when it runs (on hover by default), `origin` where it grows from and `clip` keeps it inside its box. With `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` the content stays at rest in every variant.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Combine the props and see the generated code. `scale` set to `auto` lets `intensity` define the size. With `pulse`, raise `duration` (it's the length of each cycle).

image.title: On an image
image.description: With the default `trigger` (`hover`), the image grows while the pointer is over it. `clip` is on by default, so the zoom stays inside the frame and doesn't shift the layout. The root clips, so it carries the `border-radius`.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: `in` enlarges, `out` shrinks by the same distance (`2 - scale`), `pulse` loops while active and `lens` enlarges toward the pointer. Hover over each one.

lens.title: Lens
lens.description: `lens` always follows the pointer, regardless of `origin`, and always clips. With a high `scale` it works as a magnifier on detailed images. On touch screens, with `disabledOnTouch` (default), a tap doesn't zoom: a finger can't aim the lens.

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: `origin` sets the point it grows from: center, edges or corners. `pointer` follows the cursor while it's over the box and returns to the center on leave.

triggers.title: Triggers
triggers.description: `hover` scales with the pointer or when you reach it by keyboard (visible focus on the root or inside), `click` toggles on each click and `always` holds the peak scale (or loops, with `pulse`).

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: `scale` sets the peak factor and replaces `intensity`. With `out`, the same value shrinks: `scale={1.4}` goes to `0.6`.

clip.title: Clip
clip.description: With `clip` (default) the root crops the scaled surface. With `clip={false}` the content grows over its surroundings; the scale never affects layout.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: `duration` is the scale transition in milliseconds (or the full cycle, with `pulse`). `delay` postpones the start.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: When `scale` is omitted, `intensity` sets the factor: `sm` 1.06, `md` 1.12, `lg` 1.22. It takes a token or a number between `0` and `1`.

asChild.title: asChild
asChild.description: With `asChild`, the effect is applied to the child without a wrapping `div`. Here, on a gem-system `Button`. It scales the child itself, so `clip` crops nothing: to crop an image inside its frame, use the default `div`.

state.title: Paused and disabled
state.description: `isPaused` freezes the `pulse` beat where it is. On `in`, `out` and `lens` it freezes the current scale, even mid-transition, and resumes from there when unpaused. `isDisabled` returns to normal scale and keeps the content interactive.

callbacks.title: Events
callbacks.description: `onZoom` fires when the zoom turns on and `outZoom` when it turns off, with the cause in `event.reason`. The inner button still gets clicks.

header.title: Zoom API
header.description: Reference for the props, inheritance, accessibility, CSS classes and variables, and exported types of `Zoom`.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: Playground and examples of each variant, origin and option.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from `@gem-org/gemffects/zoom` with its `zoom.css`, or from the root if you already load `styles.css`.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts the attributes of HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> except scale, and passes them to the root div (or to the child, with asChild). onClick, onPointerEnter, onPointerMove and onPointerLeave run before the effect's internal logic.

items.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the content stays at scale(1) in every variant: the pulse animation, the transitions and the in, out and lens scale are removed, and the origin stops following the pointer.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: ignoreReducedMotion (or the gemfx-ignore-reduced-motion class on an ancestor) forces the motion. Only use it if it's essential.
items.focus: With trigger="hover" the zoom also turns on with keyboard focus (:focus-visible on the root or inside), so it's visible while tabbing. A mouse click that focuses a button doesn't keep it on. onZoom only fires with the pointer.
items.click: With trigger="click" the toggle listens to the root's click. If the child is a button, it also responds to Enter and Space.
items.touch: disabledOnTouch (default true) only applies when the zoom follows the pointer (origin="pointer" or lens): a tap doesn't move the origin and the hover zoom stays at rest until a mouse or pen comes back, so the sticky :hover left by the tap doesn't zoom. With a fixed origin (center, top…) a tap zooms like hover.
items.layout: The scale is a transform: it doesn't shift the layout or resize the box. With clip, the content doesn't cover its surroundings.
items.meaning: Don't hide information behind the zoom alone: with lens, the detail should be reachable some other way too (for example, by opening the image).

items.trigger: Active trigger. With `hover`, the scale applies on `:hover` or `:focus-visible` (on the root or inside).
items.clip: Added with `clip` or `variant="lens"`. Sets `overflow: hidden` on the root.
items.pointer: Added when the origin follows the pointer (`origin="pointer"` or `lens`).
items.touchBlocked: Added when a tap reaches a pointer-tracking zoom (`origin="pointer"` or `lens`) with `disabledOnTouch`. With `hover`, it keeps the scale at rest; it's removed when a mouse or pen comes back.
items.paused: Added with `isPaused`. Pauses the `pulse` animation. On `in`, `out` and `lens`, the component pins the current scale and origin inline for as long as it's paused.
items.surface: Wraps the child. It's what scales, with `transform-origin` at `--gemfx-zoom-ox` and `--gemfx-zoom-oy`. With `asChild` it's the child itself.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: All of them are written inline on the root on every render, so a class can't override them: tune them with the props. The curve can be changed through the tokens.

items.duration: Scale transition (or `pulse` cycle). Set by `duration`; default `280ms`.
items.scale: Peak scale. Comes from `scale` or `intensity` (`1.12` by default).
items.originX: Horizontal origin in %. Fixed by `origin`, or the cursor position with `pointer` and `lens`.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Global variables Zoom reads as defaults. They can be redefined on the root with a class.

content.title: Content
content.description: Which content scales and where the effect is mounted.

timing.title: Timing
timing.description: Transition (or `pulse` cycle) and delay, in milliseconds.

state.title: Trigger and state
state.description: When it runs and how it's paused or turned off.

items.asChild: Applies the effect to the only child, without a wrapping `div`. It scales the child itself, so `clip` doesn't crop: use the default `div` if you need cropping. It injects no layers, so it also works with void elements (`img`): the element itself becomes the root.
items.variant: `in` enlarges, `out` shrinks, `pulse` loops and `lens` enlarges toward the pointer.
items.scale: Peak factor. When omitted, `intensity` sets it: `1.06`, `1.12` or `1.22`. `out` uses `2 - scale`. Negative values are treated as `0`.
items.intensity: Sets the factor when `scale` is missing. A token or a number between `0` and `1`.
items.origin: `center`, `pointer`, `top`, `right`, `bottom`, `left`, `top-left`, `top-right`, `bottom-left` or `bottom-right`. Ignored with `lens` (it always follows the pointer).
items.clip: Crops the scaled surface so it doesn't spill out of the box. `lens` always clips.
items.duration: Scale transition, or full cycle with `pulse`. Negative values are treated as `0`.
items.trigger: `hover` with the pointer or keyboard focus, `click` toggles on each click, `always` holds the scale (or loops, with `pulse`).
items.isActive: Allows the zoom. With `false` it returns to normal scale and `outZoom` gets `inactive`.
items.isPaused: Freezes the current scale (also mid-transition), the `pulse` beat and the pointer-tracking origin. While paused, clicks don't toggle with `trigger="click"`.
items.isDisabled: Stops the zoom; the child stays interactive. `outZoom` gets `disabled`.
items.disabledOnTouch: Only applies with `origin="pointer"` or `variant="lens"`: a tap doesn't move the origin and the `hover` zoom stays at rest. With a fixed origin, a tap zooms as usual. Mouse and pen are unaffected.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: Animates even if the user prefers reduced motion. Only if essential.
items.onZoom: Fires when the zoom turns on: on pointer enter, when toggled on by click, or on mount with `always`.
items.outZoom: Fires when it turns off: on pointer leave, when toggled off by click, on disable or on unmount.
items.style: Inline styles for the root. Merged with the `--gemfx-zoom-*` variables.
items.ref: Ref to the root (the `div`, or the child with `asChild`).
